notFound.title: Workflow not found
notFound.description: The workflow you're looking for doesn't exist or has been removed.

runConfirm.title: Trigger workflow now?
runConfirm.warnEmails: Real emails will be sent to all matching recipients.
runConfirm.warnUndo: This cannot be undone once started.
runConfirm.warnIntentional: Use this only when you intentionally want to fire the workflow outside its schedule.

deactivateConfirm.title: Deactivate this workflow?
deactivateConfirm.body: will become inactive. Its schedules and event triggers will be disabled.
deactivateConfirm.warnNoNewExecutions: New scheduled and event-triggered runs will stop.
deactivateConfirm.warnHistoryPreserved: All past execution history will be preserved.
deactivateConfirm.warnInProgress: Executions already in progress may continue.
deactivateConfirm.failed: Could not deactivate the workflow. Please try again.

debug.hint: Go to the Executions tab, click on a run, then press "View on Diagram" to see the visual debug flow with node-level status and logs.
